data.reasoning: The deepseek model successfully reviewed all package files (PKGBUILD, .SRCINFO, qstring.patch) and found no malicious code. The PKGBUILD uses standard CMake build steps with pinned checksums, and the patch only contains a logic bug in string formatting. The qwen model's inconclusive verdict was solely due to an API error (HTTP 400) during the PKGBUILD review, which is a tool failure rather than a security concern.
data.disagreement_analysis: The disagreement is caused by a tool error in the qwen model, which failed with an HTTP 400 error when attempting to review the PKGBUILD during the full audit phase. The deepseek model successfully reviewed the same file and found it safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to review the PKGBUILD during the full audit phase due to an LLM API error (HTTP 400).
learnings: Implement retry logic for transient LLM API errors (like HTTP 400) during file reviews to prevent a single failed request from rendering the entire audit inconclusive.
